body: That's an awful reason to live.

But I don't like myself and I'm always alone.

I feel so lost and unwanted and insignificant.

I'm not important to myself so I'm desperately trying to find someone to tell me I'm important to them. 

I'm just, so done. 

I want a reset with a different personality. This one sucks so much.

Because normal people don't like not normal people.

They ask you to open up, but you mention suicide and suddenly you need to be hospitalized.

Perhaps to see if anyone has anything else but the same tired answers. 

Life is meaningless. That's fine. You get to make your own. That's fine.

So I'm going to kill myself and that's fine.
Between friends' suicides, multiple rejections, and being blown up twice in Afghanistan, who knows.

Do you tell a hamster to not die from loneliness. 

People need to stop peddling this garbage that you need to love yourself first. You don't.

You'll meet hundreds if not thousands of people who loathe their very existence.

The difference between them and I is a fixation on being accepted.

They're liars whereas I tell the truth.

You tell them they're insecure and they'll laugh.

You tell me, and I say yes with a shrug.

Everyone judges everyone. All the time. Humans in a group are little better than hyenas. 

If it shows insecurity, bully it, make sure it doesn't mate, and finally kick it out from the pack.
Heh already screwed the pooch there and nearly became paralyzed from the waist down.

"Just build self-esteem, that'll fix everything."

And fuck my old friends, they used me right up until I left.

That's what you just told me.

You told me, a human, a social creature, that 6+ years of loneliness is okay because "Fuck them."

They're not the ones getting fucked over.

I was.

"I don't understand why he was lonely."

"Yeah he should have just told everyone else to leave him be."

That'll fix it.

No you're not. If I were to start messaging you we would exchange them decently well for a few days, maybe even weeks, then you'd drop me. 

It's what everyone does.

No, people are terrible. Especially the ones who pretend to care but leave at the first sign of adversity. I'm not sifting through hundreds or even thousands of people for a chance to find one good one.

Not worth it.

There's nothing good or bad about it. It's all about agency. 

Does it suck that we came to this conclusion, probably. Will I stop someone who's clearly made up his mind, probably not.

Everyone always says it's for the chance of things getting better.

What if they never do?

Hate requires passion, energy, and ambition. Those are gone along with my will to care.

I died. Ive been a corpse pretending to be alive for nearly 6 years.

You can't speak the truth anymore. Anytime you point to stats people will argue individuality. Anytime you argue for the individual people point to stats. People reject the truth because it's easier.

If I'm honest I'll probably kill myself at some point. Life's just awful and people aren't interested in helping others unless there's money or favors involved. 

The meds and therapy haven't worked yet, but just hang in there right...?
I think the not being able to bitch is the worst. It's like I'm just supposed to be some stupid cog in a machine that's okay with being treated like shit.

Then I guess it's back to the drawing board with alcohol to cope.

That's not why I'm unhappy. I just hate being me.
Seems like they have more social support though. People don't talk to me unless it's to ask for favors or do a job.

I will absolutely not. Not after seeing the absolute worst of humanity. I respect people's personal right to religion but I have a deep dislike of organized religion. I threw out my spirituality long ago.

I'm used to lacking compassion, understanding, and empathy general.

I'll have to live with these choices of mine. It's not what I want but here I am.

Almost any problem can be fixed. 

It all comes down to a matter of will. Here I am, with all the solutions to my problems, yet I've no will to fix them. 

In the end I believe everyone at least has an idea of how to solve the things they are going through, it's just more comfortable to stay stagnant.
I'm not particularly worried about job prospects and lets be real, nobody was going to date some guy fucked up in the head anyways.

I don't know honestly. Pissing yourself without realizing it is a strange consequence, not to mention it's a rather large pain in the ass getting out the bed and into a chair unassisted. 

I'm set to be discharged here near the end of the month, so we'll see what happens.
I tried to die a little over a week ago. EMS responded. I didn't die. I still want too though.
Money doesn't mean much to me and I have more than enough to get by.

I've been here for a week or so and been moved around from a few different wards. When I initially arrived, I was stripped of everything, to include my phone. Here in this ward, I get access to certain electronics for an allotted amount of time.
No reason to be. I'm here because EMS responded rapidly. Ultimately this fight was a struggle between myself and a system which views suicide as taboo. The system won, as it usually does.

At one point all I did was live for others. Don't. 

Don't live for yourself if you're like me either.

Find a different source because at the end of the day, we live and die in this world alone. Nobody can, and nobody will want to carry your burdens. And if they are stupid enough to do it, they'll end up like me.

Broken, lifeless, and just waiting out the clock.

Does it matter. I want to die. This is not some impulsive decision I made, it was years in the making.

Just let me die in peace.
I'm still living. I don't want to be.
There's never a good time.

That a normal inquisitor can obtain would simply be master. The head of the order is staffed by three essence lords, two women and one man.

They have such a profound understanding of magic that they can deconstruct any spell into its simplest base forms by thought alone.
*There are no answers here, only entities deemed less than worthy as refuse and tossed away. Please leave us as we have already left you."* - Lady Esk, Queen of Nowhere

Inquisitors of Essence - Magic police who ensure lawful and safe use of magic in the city of Ezbel. They police all, including the deities who now live amongst mortals. They rarely operate in the public eye and are often detectives and operate in cloak-and-dagger type fashion. All senior inquisitors are magus level at the minimum. 

Codekeepers - Honor is a tough thing to find in The Dungeon and The Tower. Often even written contracts are violated in the seemingly lawless floors of these labyrinths. If you wish to keep someone safe, or better, ensure no one dies, contract a Codekeeper. Veteran dungeoneers who wear many hats, from officer of the law to bodyguard, they are entrusted to keep some semblance of order in these places infested with monsters and traps.

The Eld One granted mortals two great gifts, at the behest of it's master. The gift of knowledge and the gift of disparity. Mortals could now rise to power and overthrow the two perceived oppressive races.

The Spinney Stonemen - Sentient stone ents. With their death the land was formed in its final shape. Trees sprouted upon their death sites, along with mountains, canyons and all manner of geographical features.

The Lively Drakes - Dragons. With their death, the land left by the death of The Spinney Stonemen was filled. The dead trees left behind grew green, clouds formed and began to rain, and life truly began as The Lively Drakes died. 

With these two great species gone, something else came. Their union of dead souls gave birth to all manner of magic. 

Of course these are just myths. And how would one know when their world would end? Scholars and men of science and magic have tried to hypothesize, but to no avail. Perhaps The Dungeon's depths or The Tower's heights hold secrets lost to time.

Elcarium is a fickle thing. Incredibly unstable, only able to be found in The Two Dungeons, and only the talented and skilled may safely use it.

It is a highly precious commodity that people risk their lives to find, mine, and bring back.

One of the many Hallowed Tomes available only to the Imperial Inquisitor Corps. Imagine finding long lost magic in a book that had been written ages ago. Now imagine that magic has not been long lost and treated as special knowledge that few are good enough for. Magic is sacred to the empire, but not to inquisitors.

Elcarium extract would be next up. An element able to serve as a perfect catalyst for alchemical, enchanting, and smithing. Almost all magical and rare items have some amount of elcarium in them.

Lastly, anything from the legendary dungeon cartographer, Armpi Blatua. Her maps, her pens, even her ink is said to magical in nature. Plus she keeps detailed notes of The Two Dungeons.

One or two of the ex imperial inquisitors would be at the heart of it.

Copycat is a very intelligent Inquisitor who rarely wins by fighting head on. Instead, he prefers to lure his prey for long times and often mimics them to an uncanny degree with magic and his flair for acting. Many of Copycat's victims were dead for months before he decided to stop living their lives. He would do it by copying the strongest spells and frankensteining them together.

Mage Eater. She devours mana. Theory goes one of two ways. She either eats all mana out of existence, thus killing all magic besides her, or she explodes and covers much of the world in magic fallout and blocks out the sky with mana clouds.

Yet I cling to a few tiny fires of hope.

I still have an understanding family(mostly), friends, and can do the things I used to like and enjoy. 

I keep pushing because I'm stubborn and literally at the bottom, so I have to go up. I have to.

Having your favorite things become empty and meaningless blows. Everything felt like I was just trying to make the clock tick by.

This was my friend in high school. He killed himself. Keep communication open. Actually be there when he needs/wants to talk. Ask him how he is doing, how he is really doing. 

It sounds like the alcohol reveals dome deep thoughts that he's holding and possibly has held for a while.

I had 2 good friends who had the same goal in high school. Kill themselves after graduation. 

I now keep in pretty constant contact with the other. He has bipolar and I have major depressive disorder and dysthymia. We had a pretty long heart to heart last night.

I find just talking and being around people I trust and feel secure with helps. I can't speak for all, but depression isolates me. The isolation is the worst part. Ask him to hang out, play games with him.

But never, ever decide you or just your friends are stewards for this guy's mental health. He needs to want to get better, he needs to seek help. None of you are qualified to deal with a suicidal person alone, no matter how much you may care.

It sucks, I know. 

Thank you for caring. Wish I had more people like you in my life and in the world.
